name: bitbucket_stop_pipeline
description: Stops one running Bitbucket pipeline, given its run number. Unless the user listed that repository (and that pipeline) as bypass, it stops NOTHING: it leaves the request in the chat with Approve and Dismiss, and only the user's click stops it. Use it only when the user asked to stop or cancel that run; take the number from bitbucket_pipelines. A stopped run cannot be resumed, only run again. Returns one line: stop requested, already finished, or the request waiting for the user.

repo.description: Repository slug, as bitbucket_repos shows it (e.g. api-orders).
